EXPSPACE.question: The _____ was Set of decision problems.
EXPSPACE.fact: In computational complexity theory, EXPSPACE is the set of all decision problems solvable by a deterministic Turing machine in exponential space, i.e., in O ( 2 p ( n ) ) {\displaystyle O(2^{p(n)})} space, where p ( n ) {\displaystyle p(n)} is a polynomial function of n {\displaystyle n}.
